en: The postcard features a black-and-white photograph of a river flowing through a forested landscape. The text on the image side reads 'Indalsälfven vid Bispgården,' indicating it depicts the Indalsälven river near Bispgården. The reverse side displays handwritten text in Swedish, an address ('Fru Elesiv Eriksson, Haagsåter, Römninge'), a Swedish postage stamp, and a postmark from 1902. There is also a printer's stamp from 'Stillssons, Stockholm.'
